senses.gloss: स- + अङ्गारक स- + अङ्गारक, adj. attended by the planet Mars.

सम्- + कट सम्- + कट,
 I. adj. (properly ‘having the hips thronged together’). 1. crowded. 2. impervious. 3. narrow, contracted.
 II. n. 1. a defile. 2. difficulty, trouble.
 III. m. a proper name.
सम्- + कथा सम्- + कथा, f. conversation.

शङ्कु- + कर्ण शङ्कु- + कर्ण,
 I. adj., f. णा, having ears like a javelin, MBh. 1, 6662; णी, Rām. 5, 18, 24.
 II. m. 1. an ass. 2. a proper name, Pañc. 87, 12.
शङ्ख-पुष्पी शङ्ख-पुष्पी, f. a sort of [] grass, Andropogon aciculatum, Man. 11, 147.
शङ्ख- + प्रवर शङ्ख- + प्रवर, m. or n. an excellent conch, Chr. 25, 60.
शङ्कित- + मनस् शङ्कित- + मनस्, adj. timid, Pañc. 104, 16.
शङ्ख- + मुक्ता शङ्ख- + मुक्ता, f. Shells and pearls, Rām. 3, 49, 36.
शङ्ख- + मुख शङ्ख- + मुख, m. an alligator.
सङ्ग- + विच्युति सङ्ग- + विच्युति, f. 1. disunion. 2. separation from worldly attachment.

शङ्क् शङ्क्, i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., Rām. 2, 90, 15),
 1. To hesitate, to be uncertain, Rām. 3, 49, 16.
 2. To doubt, MBh. 3, 16512.
 3. To think probable, to believe, MBh. 4, 97; to think, Vikr. d. 55.
 4. To distrust, to suspect, MBh. 3, 2327.
 5. To fear, Vikr. 66, 10; MBh. 3, 2274.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शङ्कित.
 1. Suspicious, Pañc. 187, 4; alarmed, frightened, Rām. 3, 52, 48.
 2. Being fearful of (with gen. and abl.), Pañc. 100, 9.
 3. Doubtful, uncertain.
 4. Weak. unsteady.
 --Comp.[]
 --Caus. To frighten, Mālav. 44, 13.
 --With the prep. अति अति,
 1. To suspect, Rām. 2, 52, 57.
 2. To fear, Rām. 2, 22, 30.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To be uncertain, Man. 8, 96.
 2. To doubt, Matsyop. 34. अभिशङ्कित,
 1. Suspecting, Chr. 14, 26.
 2. Afraid, Mālat. 143, 3.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To hesitate, Pañc. i. d. 437 (with ptcple. in the sense of an infin.).
 2. To doubt. Śāk. 66, 19.
 3. To think probable, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 2.
 4. To suspect, to apprehend, Mālat. 69, 19; Man. 7, 183.
 5. To fear, Utt. Rāmac. 62, 4.
 --With निस् निस्, निःशङ्कित (rather शङ्कित with निस्),
 1. Not hesitating, Pañc. 217, 12.
 2. Careless, ib. 161, 16.
 --With परि परि, To suspect, MBh. 3, 10356; with दोषेण, a crime or sin, Nal. 24, 26. परिशङ्कित,
 1. Suspected, Chr. 54, 15.
 2. Suspecting, Chr. 18, 36.
 3. Fearful, Lass. 2. ed. 61, 32.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To doubt, MBh. 1, 2966.
 2. To suspect, Śāk. d. 114.
 3. To fear, Mālat. 70, 13; Pañc. ii. d. 178. अ-विशङ्कित, adj. Fearless, Vikr. 81, 11.
 --With निर्वि निस्-वि, निर्विशङ्कित (rather वि-शङ्कित with निस्), acc. ˚तम्, adv. Without hesitation, Hariv. 7335.
 --With सम् सम्, To suspect, MBh. 4, 568.
 --Cf. Lat. cunc + tari; A.S. hangian; Goth. and O.H.G. hugjan; Goth. hugs; A.S. hige, hyge, hogu, hygian, hyggan, hiegan, hogian; O.H.G. hugu.

शङ्का शङ्क् + आ, f.
 1. Doubt, uncertainty, [] Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 13; Kir. 5, 42 (at the end of a comp. adj., f. का); error, 5, 38.
 2. Presumption, Nal. 24, 3.
 3. Hope, Bhartṛ. 3, 5.
 4. Fear, Pañc. 238, 21; apprehension, Hit. i. d. 23, M.M.
 --Comp.

शङ्किन् शङ्किन्, i. e. शङ्क्, and शङ्का, + इन्, adj., f. नी,
 1. Fearful of, Rājat. 5, 144.
 2. Suspecting, Hit. iv. d. 101.
 3. Full of danger, Pañc. i. d. 216.

शङ्कु शङ्क् + उ, (partly शक् + उ, cf. शक्ति), m.
 1. Fear.
 2. Śiva.
 3. Kāma.
 4. A demon.
 5. Poison.
 6. Sin.
 7. A pin, Hit. iv. d. 69; a pale, a style, Man. 8, 271; a stake.
 8. The trunk of a lopped tree.
 9. A dart, Utt. Rāmac. 75, 12; a javelin, Pañc. 87, 12 (cf. Hiḍ. 2, 4); a weapon in general.
 10. A goose.
 11. An ant-hill.
 12. A skate.
 13. A number, ten billions.
 14. A tree, Shorea robusta.
 --Comp.
शङ्कुर शङ्क् + उर, adj. Formidable.
शङ्कुला शङ्कु + ला, f. A pair of scissors (cf. दन्त-शङ्कु).

शङ्ख शङ्ख,
 I. m. and n. The conch-shell used as a vessel for offering libations, and for blowing as a horn, Pañc. 20, 8.
 II. m.
 1. A shell, Pañc. iv. d. 76; 158, 4.
 2. A military drum.
 3. The temple or temporal bone, Lass. 2. ed. 13, 13.
 4. An elephant's cheek.
 5. A large number, ten or a [] hundred billions.
 6. One of Kuvera's treasures, Pañc. ii. d. 12.
 7. A particular perfume.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. κόγχη, κόλχος, κόχλος, κάλχη.

शङ्खक शङ्ख + क,
 I. m. and n.
 1. The conch-shell.
 2. The temples, Yājñ. 3, 93.
 3. Pain in the temples and forehead.
 II. n. A bracelet.
शङ्खध्म शङ्ख-ध्म (vb. ध्मा), m. A shell-blower.

शङ्खिन् शङ्खिन्, i. e. शङ्ख + इन्,
 I. adj. Having a shell or shells.
 II. m.
 1. The ocean.
 2. A shell-blower.
 3. A worker in shells.
 4. Viṣṇu (cf. हेम-शङ्ख).
 III. f. इनी.
 1. One of the four classes into which females are divided.
 2. A female spirit.

शाङ्खिक शाङ्खिक, i. e. शङ्ख + इक,
 I. adj. Relating to a conch-shell.
 II. m.
 1. A shell-cutter.
 2. A shellblower.

सङ्ग सङ्ग, i. e. सम्-ग (vb. गम्), and सञ्ज् + अ, m.
 1. Joining, uniting, Pañc. 187, 6.
 2. Meeting, Utt. Rāmac. 33, 6.
 3. Confluence of rivers.
 4. Touch, Mālat. 170, 3.
 5. Association, Hit. i. d. 202, M.M.; Pañc. i. d. 224; keeping company, Bhartṛ. 2, 34; intercourse, friendship, love (कान्ता-, of one's wife), Pañc. v. d. 83.
 6. Attaching, Ragh. 2, 42 (an arrow, i. e. throwing).
 7. Attachment, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 600; Pañc. i. d. 194; wordly attachment, Bhag. 2, 48.
 8. Desire, cupidity, [] Indr. 4, 3; Daśak. in Chr. 181, 3.
 --Comp.

साङ्ग साङ्ग, i. e. स-अङ्ग, adj.
 1. With the members, divisions.
 2. Complete, finished, Utt. Rāmac. 166, 2.

सङ्गिन् सङ्गिन्, i. e. सङ्ग + इन्, adj., f. नी,
 1. Uniting with.
 2. Attached, devoted to, Bhag. 3, 26.
 3. Lustful, libidinous.

साङ्कर्य साङ्कर्य, i. e. संकर + य, n.
 1. Mixture.
 2. The concurrence of various properties in one subject.
साङ्काश्या साङ्काश्या, i. e. संकाश + य, f. Name of a town, Rām. 1, 70, 3.
साङ्क्षेपिक साङ्क्षेपिक, i. e. संक्षेप + इक, adj. Short, summary.

साङ्ख्य साङ्ख्य, i. e. संख्य + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Numeral, relating to number.
 2. Deliberating, reasoning, Bhag. 3, 3.
 3. Rational, discriminative.
 II. m. The Sāṅkhya system of philosophy, Bhāg. P. 5, 18, 33; Bhag. 2, 39.

साङ्गतिक साङ्गतिक, i. e. संगति + इक,
 I. adj. Associating.
 II. m.
 1. A visitor.
 2. One who comes on business, Man. 3, 103.
साङ्ग्रामिक साङ्ग्रामिक, i. e. संग्राम + इक, adj., f. का, Relating to war, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 6; Pañc. i. d. 103; warlike, martial.
